Ifølge Frankrigs indenrigsministerium har 70.000 mennesker lørdag deltaget i en overvejende fredelig demonstration i Paris.
Klokken 14.00 lød status fra politiet i den franske hovedstad, at 27 personer var anholdt.
En uge tidligere meldte politiet om 217 anholdelser.
På landsplan har omkring 320.000 mennesker indtaget gaderne rundt om i Frankrig, lyder vurderingen fra det franske ministerium.
Der er indsat omkring 70.000 politifolk for at holde ro og orden.

France is deploying 70,000 police officers and gendarmes across the country as authorities brace for another weekend of protests and possible violence over rising living costs, deteriorating public services and growing dissatisfaction with President Emmanuel Macron's government.

Police have also prohibited access to Place de la Republique and Les Halles, two locations affected by the previous unrest, between 11 p.m. and 6 a.m. on Saturday and Sunday.

With public debt approaching 120% of economic output and borrowing costs rising, the government faces mounting pressure to reduce spending, leaving limited room to accommodate demands for greater investment in education and financial relief for households.
Authorities counted approximately 550,000 demonstrators nationwide on Oct.

items.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed the lives of Ukrainians under constant Russian attacks and diplomatic efforts to achieve peace during a meeting with King Willem-Alexander of the Netherlands.
items.title_da: Zelensky diskuterer russiske angreb og fredsbestræbelser med den hollandske konge
items.summary_da: Præsident Volodymyr Zelensky drøftede ukrainernes liv under konstante russiske angreb og diplomatiske bestræbelser på at opnå fred under et møde med kong Willem-Alexander i Nederlandene.
